boundary: Compares trainable original MINDS public-code baseline against KT2JointModel on the same FOREST-source datasets. Handcrafted/heuristic baselines are excluded from the improvement verdict. preflight evidence proves the pipeline and a directional comparison only; full_validation_passed=true is required before claiming final KT2 improvement over MINDS.

rows.methodology: Original MINDS public-code adapter: sequential hypergraphs, adversarial learning, macro/micro diffusion prediction.

candidate_protocol_audit.candidate_source: train-set popularity/transitions/hyper-coactivation plus observed-prefix social neighbors

rows.trend_time_supervision: timestamp-aware full-horizon normalized checkpoints with count-proportional fallback
rows.methodology: MINDS original public-code DynamicCasHGNN/Fusion/SharedLSTM components are active; MINDS original Module.forward/RelationGNN auxiliary is active; FOREST-style masked next-user policy with sampled growth reward and macro/micro consistency + CasFT continuous trend branch (disabled; disabled; disabled)
rows.baseline_role: KT2 candidate model compared against trainable MINDS/FOREST/CasFT baselines; handcrafted baselines are sanity checks only
rows.note: KT2 formal local joint model: prefix-feature encoder plus GRU sequence encoder, MINDS original public-code DynamicCasHGNN/Fusion/SharedLSTM components are active; MINDS original Module.forward/RelationGNN auxiliary is active; macro size head, micro next-hop policy head, CasFT-style Euler neural-ODE trend decoder, shared-state-conditioned trend denoising auxiliary, and FOREST-style masked next-user policy plus sampled growth reward and macro/micro consistency loss. It is not an original FOREST, MINDS, CasFT, DyGFormer, or HyperIDP reproduction.

research_migration.MINDS: MINDS original public-code DynamicCasHGNN/Fusion/SharedLSTM components are active; MINDS original Module.forward/RelationGNN auxiliary is active; gradient-reversal task/stage adversaries, and macro/micro orthogonality regularizer approximate cross-cascade diffusion state and task disentanglement; this is KT2's trainable MINDS-based foundation/fallback bridge, not the MINDS paper's native dataset protocol or full paper-scale reproduction
research_migration.FOREST: observed activation-sequence GRU, event-level masked next-user policy loss, REINFORCE-style sampled growth reward over legal candidates, macro-quality reward weighting, and macro/micro count-consistency constrain scale and next-hop predictions; optional upstream FOREST RNNModel/RRModel auxiliary status=disabled; this is a KT2 bridge and optional original-component auxiliary, not the full FOREST training protocol or paper-scale RRModel validation
research_migration.CasFT: trend branch is an Euler neural-ODE-style decoder with shared-state-conditioned Gaussian trend denoising auxiliary; it is not the original CasFT diffusion generator
research_migration.DyGFormer_TGN: micro branch remains a temporal next-hop ranking task over leak-checked candidates

macro_log_support.source: train macro and CasFT-style trend log-size labels

joint_training.shared_encoder: fusion of prefix/candidate MLP, observed-sequence GRU, and cross-cascade context encoder

macro_log_support.source: train macro and CasFT-style trend log-size labels

joint_training.sequence_encoder: GRU over observed t_obs activation sequence, fused with upstream FOREST RNNModel hidden state when enabled
joint_training.cross_context_encoder: GRU plus attention pooling over MINDS-style sequential transition/social/hyper-coactivation context fused with dynamic prefix-hyperedge memory
joint_training.minds_dynamic_hypergraph: upstream MINDS DynamicCasHGNN over dhg.Hypergraph prefix snapshots when enabled; otherwise event-level DynamicCasHGNN bridge aggregates prefix user embeddings as sequential hyperedges and fuses them over time with a MINDS-style Fusion gate
joint_training.trend_auxiliary: Euler neural-ODE-style trend decoder supervised on 4 future cumulative-size checkpoints
joint_training.diffusion_auxiliary: shared-state-conditioned Gaussian noising and denoising loss over normalized future trend checkpoints
joint_training.adversarial_regularizer: gradient-reversal task/stage adversaries over shared propagation state
joint_training.reinforced_coupling: FOREST-style event policy bridge: masked next-user policy loss plus REINFORCE-style sampled growth reward over legal candidates
joint_training.methodology: MINDS original public-code DynamicCasHGNN/Fusion/SharedLSTM components are active; MINDS original Module.forward/RelationGNN auxiliary is active; adversarial disentanglement, FOREST RNN hidden-state fusion plus masked next-user policy, sampled growth reward and macro/micro consistency, CasFT neural-ODE-style trend decoding with shared-state-conditioned Gaussian noising and denoising loss over normalized future trend checkpoints and disabled or runtime fallback
joint_training.trend_target: future cumulative cascade size checkpoints after t_obs
joint_training.trend_time_supervision: timestamp-aware full-horizon normalized checkpoints with count-proportional fallback
joint_training.consistency_loss: MSE(log1p(macro predicted growth), log1p(sum sigmoid(candidate logits))) plus macro-reward-weighted event-level masked next-user policy loss and FOREST-style sampled growth reward
joint_training.original_component_distillation: When enabled, upstream MINDS Module.forward macro predictions, FOREST RRModel sampled EOS sizes, and CasFT CombinedSpatiotemporalModel5 size predictions are used as training teacher signals; CasFT CombinedSpatiotemporalModel5 also provides a prefix-only continuous-time size/trend signal gated into KT2's main macro/trend outputs.
